scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India
target_group: Street vendors, hawkers, daily wage workers, and self-employed micro-entrepreneurs

eligibility_rules.description: Engaged in self-employment, street vending, or daily wage informal commerce
Operates an active bank account in own name
No family member paid income tax last year

benefits.amount: Rs 10,000 in first tranche; up to Rs 50,000 in subsequent tranches with 7% interest subsidy
benefits.instalments: Direct bank credit with monthly cashback incentives on digital UPI transactions

required_documents: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body (ULB) Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_steps: Visit the PM SVANidhi Portal at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or apply via local Banking Correspondent / MeeSeva / CSC
Link Aadhaar and verify mobile number via OTP
Select lending institution (Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank, or SHG)
Submit vending identification details and receive instant in-principle sanction
source_document: PM SVANidhi Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
